versions.changelog:
**Weekly summary scheduling and recap feature added.**

- Added weekly recap automation via a new summary flow (Sundays at 21:00 local time, with single job per user).
- All weekly summaries use the new content/structure in references/weekly-summary.md.
- Updated SKILL.md workflow to include weekly summary setup and delivery rules.
- Added references/weekly-summary.md; removed deprecated skill-card.md.

- Added daily food budget support: users can now set a daily budget with currency.
- Provides cost estimates for ingredients needed; suggests cheaper swaps if over budget.
- New [references/budget.md] with fixed cost labels and rules for food budgeting.
- Updated boundaries: never present food cost as an exact price and never mix currencies.
- Documentation refinements and updated version number.

fitness-assistant v0.1.5 adds three-day review, a training log, and supports fixed dialogues in 8 languages.

- Uses opening and review dialogues from new `references/dialogues.md` for consistent, localized conversations.
- Automatically starts a three-day review dialogue if 3+ days have passed since the last confirmed plan, instead of reusing old settings.
- Adds a training log: when the user reports a workout, logs the session details and uses recent data to personalize future plans and recovery.
- When ingredients for today are shared, recommends specific dishes built around them.
- Ensures all messages use fixed language templates and dialogues for the chosen language.
- Removed `skill-card.md` as part of content cleanup.

fitness-assistant 0.1.3

- Added an opening message to introduce the skill and guide the user on what info to prepare.
- Onboarding flow now asks for training time and intensity, ingredient choices, and handles "you decide"/"随便" responses with clear defaults.
- Meal and workout planning now factor in preferred training time and intensity.
- Workflow and prompts updated for greater clarity and user customization.
- Added references/opening.md; removed deprecated skill-card.md.

Version 0.1.1 Changelog

- Added customizable meal ingredient options per user preference; menus can now include user-chosen ingredients for each meal.
- Updated logic to save and reuse preferred ingredients in future daily plans.
- Improved calorie target accuracy: each daily meal plan now assembled within ±100 kcal of the target.
- Removed redundant file (skill-card.md).
- Updated documentation across skill and reference files for new ingredient customization features.

- Initial release of Fitness Assistant, providing personalized one-day meal and workout plans based on user age, health profile, and preferences.
- Supports automated daily delivery of plans in 8 languages with timezone localization via OpenClaw scheduling.
- Ensures safety by setting dietary minimums and recommending professional advice for special health conditions.
- Collects and uses only necessary user profile information, without generating or assuming health data.
- Follows structured workflow for plan creation and automation, with clear boundaries for language support and medical guidance.
